_comment: Figures on monogate.dev and the claims retired from it, checked by scripts/check_site_figures.mjs. A claim names a repo file, a regex whose FIRST capture group is the figure as written, a source, and a relation: `equal`, or `floor` for a figure written N+ (the source must be at least N). A `url` source fetches text and extracts a number; a `count` source counts regex matches in a repo file. An unevaluable source is UNAVAILABLE (exit 2), never a pass. A claim whose pattern stops matching FAILS. To put a number on a page, add its claim here in the same change.

machlib_core_theorems._note: machlib's own prose gate keeps this README row equal to `python3 tools/count_theorems.py --scope core`; 7 672 on 2026-09-12.

claims._note: Written as a floor so every new machlib theorem does not fail the deploy; a correction that drops the count below it does.

retired.why: Retired 2026-09-12: not every kernel has a proof. eml-stdlib's hann_in_unit_interval depends on sorryAx, and the compiler's shipped stdlib carries no @verify contract at all.

Retired 2026-09-12: reads as 'every proof closed'. Say 'Lean theorem' and show #print axioms, which is what tells proved from stated. A line that keeps the label must also be a registered site in scripts/lean_claims.json, whose gate re-proves it on every deploy.

allow.reason: names one theorem (T17), not every kernel. The proof is not vouched for here but gated: this line is a site of claim T19-strict-i-unconstructible in scripts/lean_claims.json. Before every deploy, check_claims.py requires T19_i_unconstructible_strict to be declared in StrictBarrier.lean at the pinned monogate-research sha, compile in monogate-lean, and report no sorryAx. The lean4/i_unconstructibility.lean the page cited never existed; the evidence text now says so. next.config.mjs redirects /theorems to monogate.org, so this page is not served.

names one theorem (T19), not every kernel. The proof is not vouched for here but gated: this line is a site of claim T19-strict-i-unconstructible in scripts/lean_claims.json. Before every deploy, check_claims.py requires T19_i_unconstructible_strict and strict_barrier_T19 to be declared in monogate-research/lean/EML/StrictBarrier.lean at the pinned sha, compile in monogate-lean (toolchain and Mathlib pinned), and report only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. It holds because the strict evaluator is typed into the reals.

retired.why: Retired 2026-09-12: the invented `sorry -- TODO: prove against MachLib` output. Real Forge output ends in `| sorry -- out of reach` as the LAST tactic arm, present whether or not an earlier arm closed the goal.

retired.phrase: means the proof is still open
retired.why: Retired 2026-09-12: the word sorry in an emitted file says nothing. sorryAx in #print axioms is the signal.
No paid tier exists: ALL_TIERS_FREE is True in the compiler, and monogateforge.com says every target is free.
argparse rejects a comma list. One target per command, or --target all.
